missing_information_behavior: If dietary intake, age/life stage or current supplement use is missing, do not calculate a dose; request context and consider clinical assessment where indicated.
safety_exclusions: Do not diagnose vitamin D deficiency from low sun exposure alone.
Do not encourage unprotected UV exposure as a treatment.
Do not recommend high-dose vitamin D without clinical indication and safety review.
professional_escalation_conditions: Kidney disease, hypercalcemia, kidney stones, malabsorption, granulomatous disease or pregnancy.
Bone pain, muscle weakness, suspected deficiency or abnormal calcium/25(OH)D results.
population_and_context: People reporting limited sun exposure; sunlight is only one determinant of vitamin D status, alongside diet, skin synthesis, age, geography, season and health factors.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Use life-stage dietary reference values; serum 25(OH)D testing and dosing decisions depend on clinical indication and local guidance.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin D fact sheet describes sources, status markers and risk factors. Sun exposure alone cannot establish deficiency or an individualized dose.
